title: Branch deploys
description: Give a branch its own stable URL that rebuilds on every push. Removed when the branch is deleted or goes idle.

settings.patternsHint: One per line. Use an exact name or a pattern such as feature/* (a star matches any characters).
settings.productionNote: The production branch ({{branch}}) is never listed here: it deploys as the app itself.
settings.idleNote: A branch deploy with no push for {{hours}} hours is removed.

list.title: Live branch deploys
list.emptyOff: Turn on branch deploys above, then push to a matching branch.
list.emptyOn: Push to a matching branch and its deploy shows up here.
list.noUrl: No URL (set an apps base domain or a primary domain)
list.expires: Removed if there is no new push:

deleteDialog.title: Delete the {{branch}} deploy?
deleteDialog.description: Its URL stops working. The next push to the branch deploys it again.
deleteDialog.consequence: The deploy, its containers and its DNS record are removed.
deleteDialog.error: Could not delete the branch deploy.
